=== data directives
        db 1,2,3
        defb $ff, 0FFh, %101
        db 'abc', "de", 0
        db 'x'+1
        defm "text"
        dw $1234, 5678h, msg
        defw 1
        ds 3
        defs 2,$aa
        ds 4,0ffh
msg:    db 0
=== equates, forward and backward
count   equ 10
        ld b,count
        ld hl,table
        ld de,table+count
        ld a,last-table
table:  ds 10
last:   ld c,size
size    equ last-table
=== defl can be redefined
n       defl 1
        ld a,n
n       defl n+1
        ld a,n
=== the location counter
        jr $
        djnz $+2
        ld hl,$
        dw $, $+1, $
        jp $+3
=== relative jumps at the ends of their range
top:    jr nz,fwd
        ds 127
fwd:    jr z,top2
top2:   ds 126
        jr c,top2
        djnz top2+2
=== a print loop
        ld hl,msg
loop:   ld a,(hl)
        or a
        ret z
        call putc
        inc hl
        jr loop
putc:   push hl
        ld e,a
        ld c,2
        call 5
        pop hl
        ret
msg:    db 'Hello, world',13,10,0
=== index registers with symbolic displacements
dx      equ 4
dy      equ -2
        ld ix,buf
        ld a,(ix+dx)
        ld (iy+dy),a
        set 7,(ix+dx+1)
        bit 0,(iy+dy-1)
        ld (ix+dx),count
count   equ 3
buf:    ds 8
=== block copy
        ld hl,src
        ld de,dst
        ld bc,len
        ldir
        ret
src:    db 1,2,3,4
len     equ $-src
dst:    ds len
=== interrupt vectors and restarts
        di
        im 2
        ld a,vec >> 8
        ld i,a
        ei
        rst 38h
        reti
vec:    dw isr
isr:    ex af,af'
        exx
        exx
        ex af,af'
        ei
        reti
=== comments and case
        LD A,5          ; load
        Ld (IX+1),A     ; mixed
Loop:   DJNZ Loop       ; spin
        JP Loop
=== expressions
        ld a,1+2*3
        ld a,(1+2)*3
        ld a,7 % 3
        ld a,$f0 | $0f
        ld a,$ff & $0f
        ld a,$ff ^ $0f
        ld a,~$0f & $ff
        ld hl,1 << 15
        ld hl,$8000 >> 4
        ld a,-1
        ld a,'A'
        ld hl,lab & $ffff
lab:    ret
